title: Ruscus aculeatus tea for medicinal use
intro: Ruscus aculeatus tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves of the butcher's broom plant, which is known for its vascular-supporting properties. It is traditionally used in herbalism to strengthen blood vessels and improve circulation, particularly in the legs. This tea may help alleviate symptoms of varicose veins and venous insufficiency by promoting better blood flow. It is often prepared by steeping the dried leaves in hot water and consumed as a daily tonic. In some cultures, it is also used to support cardiovascular health and reduce swelling.
